O2_READY_FOR_SHARED_OPERATOR_TEST_requir.A: at least one coherent ROI set with reproducible B0 operator evidence (>=3 ROIs O4>O0 Holm-significant in O1)
O2_READY_FOR_SHARED_OPERATOR_TEST_requir.B: those ROIs NOT explained primarily by baseline-ceiling artifact (FM1 != BASELINE_CEILING_PLAUSIBLE for the evidence set)
O2_READY_FOR_SHARED_OPERATOR_TEST_requir.C: operator stability at least MODERATE for the evidence set (median action_cosine >= 0.50)
O2_READY_FOR_SHARED_OPERATOR_TEST_requir.D: a cross-subject measurement contract can be frozen (B0, identity centroids, common-space method to be validated in O2)
O2_READY_FOR_SHARED_OPERATOR_TEST_requir.E: B0 measurement dependence explicitly acknowledged (B1 non-replication recorded)

v2_hv4_rule: must NOT be silently dropped; exclusion from primary O2 justified prospectively from O1/O1.1 evidence
o2_method_note: O1.1 does NOT select the common-space method; only determines scientific justification. O2 critical test = LEAVE_ONE_SUBJECT_OUT + HELD_OUT_STIMULUS_IDENTITIES.
